assets.prompt: The Crypt Mite, a horde swarmer: a round knot of dark staff Wood broken out of an old crypt staff, scuttling on four thin root-legs, with a little Bone ferrule. Small and squat (about 10x10 px of body) so hundreds read as a swarm; its one eye floats on the knot. A 32x32 body with its ferrule at the bottom (row 28), 1px dark outline, light from the top-left; the face (eye and brow) is a separate layer. Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no player colours.
